description: Bring an attached Schema's segment & node TYPES into the Layers panel as foldable Segment / Node layer blocks.
instructions: Reads an attached Schema's segment `type` (role seg-type) and node `type` (role node-type) discriminators — their options — and surfaces them to the host as live LAYER blocks: a foldable 'Segment' block (Wall / Door / Window / Line) and 'Node' block (Junction / Object) in the Layers panel. Live-derived (not saved); removing the node returns the panel to just Layer 0. Wire a Schema into the Schema input. No geometry.
